title: Semantic Index Polish — Readable Hits, Deterministic Read, Truthful State
repo_context: Close the semantic indexing yellow-zone: preview excerpts + provenance trace, deterministic locate→read expansion, truthful manifest/model identity, explicit failure modes, safe update semantics, and reliable persistence tests.

stories.title: Add deterministic preview excerpt to semantic hits (store + return)
acceptance_criteria: Semantic hits include a non-empty preview/excerpt field suitable for triage (deterministic for the same chunk)
Preview is persisted in the semantic metadata store (so it works across restarts)
A pytest indexes a small fixture and asserts semantic lane evidence contains non-empty preview for returned hits
stories.notes: Preview is for triage/debug, not final answer context. Keep it small and deterministic.

stories.title: Ensure FINAL_SEGMENTS hit metadata has full CorpusEntryRef fidelity (hydrateable)
acceptance_criteria: Semantic hit metadata can reconstruct a fully-populated CorpusEntryRef for FINAL_SEGMENTS (includes required ids such as segment_id and draft_id)
A pytest demonstrates that hydrating the returned ref yields non-empty entry text (fixture-based; no external server dependency)
No 'unimplemented_hydration' is returned for FINAL_SEGMENTS hits in the fixture case
stories.notes: Prefer storing the needed ref fields in SQLite (or a canonical serialized ref blob) so the lane can reconstruct faithfully.

stories.title: Add explicit read-mode service: Evidence → full hydrated entry (locate→read bridge)
acceptance_criteria: A new read-mode helper/service exists that takes a semantic hit/evidence reference and returns the full hydrated parent CorpusEntry
Read-mode is separate from the semantic lane (lane stays locator; read does heavy hydration)
A pytest shows a semantic result can be expanded to full text deterministically via the read service
stories.notes: Keep this API small and explicit. It can initially hydrate full parent entry; selector-based windows can be a follow-up story if needed.

stories.title: Make manifest truth real: builder writes/updates manifest on successful build; lane compares correctly
acceptance_criteria: Successful index build writes/updates manifest.json for the pool (verified by pytest fixture build)
Manifest includes unambiguous model identity (human-readable model id + immutable revision/fingerprint) and embedding_dim + policy id
Lane detects manifest mismatch and returns explicit stale status without rebuilding on query
stories.notes: Do not trigger silent rebuilds in query paths; surface 'stale / needs reindex'.

stories.title: Make operational index failure modes explicit: missing vs unavailable/corrupt vs stale
acceptance_criteria: Lane distinguishes: index_not_initialized (files absent), index_unavailable (present but failed to load), and index_stale_needs_reindex (manifest mismatch)
Each failure mode includes actionable debug/provenance fields (pool identifier and an error/category string)
A pytest creates these states via temp directories (missing files, corrupt sqlite, mismatched manifest) and asserts the correct status
stories.notes: This is about operational clarity; avoid conflating states into a single 'None'.

stories.title: Make update semantics provably safe: never reuse deleted labels; idempotent upsert behavior
acceptance_criteria: Updating/reindexing the same chunk_id does not reuse deleted labels in the ANN index (new label allocated; old label tombstoned)
Upserting the same chunk_id repeatedly is idempotent at the public API level (no duplicate public IDs in query results)
A pytest runs a loop of N updates and queries and asserts integrity (no crashes; expected hit remains retrievable)
stories.notes: Choose safe-by-design semantics rather than relying on questionable in-place replacement behavior.

stories.title: Make persistence tests reliable: isolate HNSW integration tests if needed (no permanent ignores)
acceptance_criteria: No guidance in-repo suggests permanently ignoring persistence tests to avoid crashes
If isolation is needed, HNSW integration tests are explicitly marked and runnable in a separate pytest invocation
Project docs/commands include how to run both the normal suite and the isolated HNSW suite deterministically
stories.notes: CI wiring may be out of scope if no CI config exists; focus on a reliable local strategy and clear commands.

stories.title: Standardize 'why this matched' trace in semantic evidence (score + policy + pool + model identity)
acceptance_criteria: Each semantic evidence item includes structured debug/provenance fields: pool identifier, similarity score/distance, chunking policy id, and embedding model identity
A pytest asserts these fields are present and stable for a deterministic fixture
stories.notes: Keep trace minimal but sufficient for tuning and audit.
